Enum Class ResourceType

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<ResourceType>
it.polimi.ingsw.am02.common.enumerations.ResourceType
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<ResourceType>, Constable
public enum ResourceType extends Enum<ResourceType>
Enumerates every resource tracked per player and reported in ResourceDelta notifications.
  • PRESTIGE_POINTS — the main victory-point currency
  • FOOD — used to sustain the tribe and purchase buildings
  • SHAMAN_STARS — used in Shamanic Ritual event scoring
  • FOOD_DISCOUNT — cumulative reduction to food costs (Gatherers, some buildings)
  • BUILDING_DISCOUNT — cumulative reduction to building purchase costs (Builders)
  • PP_BUILDERS — prestige points credited specifically to Builder characters
  • PP_BUILDINGS — prestige points credited to owned buildings
